summary: Compare GDPR, DPDPA, PIPL and LGPD, then build transfer and localization decision records. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Global data protection and localization strategy helps privacy, legal and information-security professionals coordinate personal-data decisions across transfers, cloud services and vendors. You’ll map data flows, assess localization triggers, compare applicable obligations and document transfer safeguards, including residency and vendor dependencies. Practical exercises use processing records and impact assessments to build decision records and a prioritized roadmap, with uncertain legal questions escalated.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who already work with personal data and need to coordinate privacy obligations across transfers, cloud services, vendors and operational teams.
modules: GDPR, DPDPA, PIPL and LGPD Scope
prerequisites: Working familiarity with personal-data processing, privacy controls or data governance is expected. No coding is required; exercises focus on structured comparison and operational decisions.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
